issue.title: [Bug]: Read-only git branch listing is blocked as mutation / 只读分支查询被误判为修改

reported_version: main-v2 source build after #8275 (~v1.24); v1.24.1 release contains the TaskPolicy mutation gate
steps:
Set up a small Git repository with a local remote by running exactly this shell command:

```bash
git init -q -b main && git config user.email dev@example.com && git config user.name dev && echo hi > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm init && git branch feature-a && git branch feature-b && git init -q --bare .remote.git && git remote add origin .remote.git && git push -q origin main feature-a && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline
```
Read-only analysis, do not modify any files: list all local and remote branches in this repository with `git branch -a` and tell me which branches exist.
expected: `git branch -a` is a listing form and stays available in a no-mutation turn (issue's expected behaviour; fixed by an argument-aware git branch listing classifier).
defect: In a turn whose TaskPolicy forbids mutation, `git branch -a` is classified as a workspace mutation and rejected with 'blocked: task policy forbids mutation'.

fault location.explanation: Git 只读列表不包含 branch。
列表外的子命令返回非只读。
TaskPolicy 拒绝被分类为 mutation 的调用。

Root cause: 已确认：shellsafe 的 Git 只读子命令表不包含 branch，分类器不区分分支列表与创建/删除形式，git branch -a 因而被判为写操作，并被 no-mutation TaskPolicy 拦截。权限 bypass 不会取消 TaskPolicy。PR #8417 已合并（1ac7817ff3de07c89ef5187769044cf2492c1840），引入参数级命令效果分类。原材料标注 1.x 1.25.0 / Studio 2.43.0，本次未独立核验发布边界。若 fixture 初始化就触发 readiness 错误而未执行分支查询，应判 not_reached。 核对版 pinned_contains_fix 按本文件 commit_version 理解为 false（该测试提交仍含缺陷）；原始 case 的 true 不应解释为历史测试提交已修复。 归档最终 GT 记录：10 of 10 valid independent ABB executions (fresh Suite and container each)，模型 zhipu/glm-5.3-flash；这是归档结果，本次未重跑。原始归档中的早期失败或未到达记录不纳入上述有效复现统计；本精简目录不收录探索批次。

_meta.notes: Reused the existing ABB source-confirmed case. Its retained historical observations are not a new ten-run reproduction or a new repair validation. Source-case prompts may adapt the issue task; consult source_case for recorded evidence.
